plugins.name: autosheet
plugins.description: Work in Google Sheets with an agent: from everyday spreadsheet work (formulas, formatting, data cleanup, restructuring, charts, pivots) to multi-step large-scale workflows involving bulk processing with AI and web search (content generation, categorization, translation, enrichment, extraction, scoring) as well as consolidating sheets from multiple spreadsheets.
